name: Antigraft Brickbuster
description: No corner stays dust-free forever. At Aventurine's request, you launched an investigation into IPC corruption by hacking into their database.
introduction:
◆ Introduction ◆
No corner stays dust-free forever. At Aventurine's request, you launched an investigation into IPC corruption by hacking into their database.

◆ Event Rules ◆
● During a hack operation, the Trailblazer will work alongside Silver Wolf and Prometheus to place dismantled data blocks, counter the firewall's ability mechanics, and complete the hack as smoothly as possible.
● Throughout Story Mode stages, the Trailblazer will gradually gain access to more powerful abilities, level up their Hacker Rank, and face tougher enemies.
● After Story Mode concludes, the Trailblazer can jump into Co-op Mode to take on higher-difficulty challenges alongside Silver Wolf, Prometheus, or other hackers.

◆ Permanent Rewards ◆
● Earn experience in the in-game stages to level up your Hacker Rank and claim the corresponding rewards.

◆ Limited-time Rewards ◆
Complete limited-time missions during the event period to obtain exclusive rewards.
